title: 第25章 此去祁都第26章 又不是没杀过
content_zh:
第25章此去祁都黑暗笼罩天地，整座白家，仿佛都陷入了黑暗的世界之中，阴沉而压抑。
而这黑暗世界的中心，正是那幽暗火莲，或者说，焮儿！
幽冥火莲扎根在她身上，她浑身都被黑暗力量包裹，让人无法靠近！
就连萧沉都没搞明白，为何焮儿体内会出现这等异样的变化。
她如黑暗之源，要让黑暗君临这片大地！
“莫非焮儿……”
萧沉内心涌现一个大胆的猜想，他联想到了自己的道骨，焮儿的体质，有可能也不同于常人！
只是，这也太不同了！
“不对，这是一股焮儿无法控制的力量！”
萧沉神色担忧，焮儿受到了掌印的攻击陷入昏迷，这股黑暗力量完全是被动激活的，自行爆发！
灰袍人眉头紧皱，这变故显然超出了他的预料！
这幽冥火莲带给了他前所未有的危险气息！
他甚至觉得，只要他稍微靠近一些那幽冥火莲，就会被黑暗吞噬，永世沉沦其中。
轰！
就在灰袍人考虑是否该撤退时，幽冥火莲骤然间爆发出无与伦比的恐怖气息，似有无尽的黑暗力量降临他的身上，他的双瞳瞬间化作漆黑之色，犹如不见底的深渊般。
“他被黑暗侵袭了！”
萧沉眼眸一凝，黑暗入体，纵然是玄府境强者，也难以抵挡。
“不！”
灰袍人惊恐地呼喊，他的面孔都变得狰狞，像是极为痛苦。
他的四周出现了一尊尊虚幻的黑暗巨兽，疯狂噬咬着他的身体，明明没有真实的血肉，可利爪和血盆大口却能将灰袍人的身体都撕碎来。

白家和远风城的人都惊呆了，一尊玄府境的强者，先前如同神明般高高在上，俯瞰众人，此刻竟然沦落到如此凄惨的地步。
“那些缠绕他的黑暗力量从何而来，为何，要将他摧毁？”
人群心头颤栗，他们能看到的情形有限，根本不知这黑暗力量的源头在哪儿。
嗡！
萧沉的道骨世界仿佛也感染到了黑暗气息，传出可怕的异动，尤其是其中一颗星辰，更是剧烈的颤动着，像是对外界的黑暗力量无比渴望。
这是暗夜君主，曾执掌黑夜，天生亲近黑暗大道，要让诸天万界陷入永夜之中！
嘭！
就在萧沉努力想要镇压道骨世界异动的时候，一道身体从天坠落，重重的摔在了他面前。
实际上，这已经不能称之为身体，只有骨架和人皮，血肉都被黑暗力量吞噬殆尽！
“就这么死了？”
萧沉似乎有些不敢相信，一尊玄府境强者，就这么被黑暗杀死了？
亦或者，算是死在了焮儿的手中？
白家的人也感觉有些梦幻，灰袍人随意散发的威压，都能震退他们的家主，却这样不明不白的死了。
轰！
击杀了灰袍人之后，幽冥火莲似乎又盯上了萧沉，汹涌的黑暗之力朝着他怒啸而来！
content_en:
Chapter 25 After leaving Qidu, darkness shrouded the world, and the entire Bai family seemed to have fallen into a dark world, gloomy and depressing.
And the center of this dark world is the Dark Fire Lotus, or in other words, Zhen'er!
The Netherworld Fire Lotus took root on her body, and her whole body was wrapped in dark power, making it impossible for anyone to get close!
Even Xiao Chen didn't understand why such strange changes occurred in Yan'er's body.
She is like the source of darkness, and she wants darkness to rule this land!
"Could it be Zhan'er..."
A bold conjecture emerged in Xiao Chen's heart. He thought of his own moral integrity, and Zhan'er's physique might be different from ordinary people!
But, this is so different!
"No, this is a force that Zhen'er cannot control!"
Xiao Chen looked worried. Yan'er was attacked by the palm print and fell into a coma. This dark power was completely passively activated and broke out on its own!
The man in gray robe frowned, this change was obviously beyond his expectation!
This Netherworld Fire Lotus gave him an unprecedented dangerous aura!
He even felt that as long as he got a little closer to the Netherworld Fire Lotus, he would be swallowed up by darkness and sink into it forever.
boom!
Just when the man in gray robe was considering whether to retreat, the Netherworld Fire Lotus suddenly erupted with an unparalleled terrifying aura. It seemed like endless dark power descended on him, and his pupils instantly turned into pitch black, like a bottomless abyss.
"He was invaded by darkness!"
Xiao Chen's eyes narrowed, and darkness entered his body. Even a strong man in the Xuanfu realm could not resist it.
"No!"
The man in gray robe shouted in terror, his face became ferocious, as if he was in great pain.
Illusory dark giant beasts appeared around him, biting his body crazily. There was no real flesh and blood, but the sharp claws and bloody mouth could tear the gray-robed man's body to pieces.
The people of the Bai family and Yuanfeng City were all shocked. A powerful man in the Xuanfu realm, who had previously been as high as a god, overlooking everyone, was now reduced to such a miserable state.
"Where did the dark forces that entangled him come from, and why did they want to destroy him?"
The crowd was trembling. What they could see was limited, and they had no idea where the source of this dark power was.
Buzz!
Xiao Chen's Taogu world seemed to be infected with the dark atmosphere, and there were terrible movements. One of the stars in particular was trembling violently, as if it was extremely hungry for the dark power of the outside world.
This is the Lord of Dark Night, who once controlled the night and was born close to the dark road. He wants to plunge all heavens and worlds into eternal night!
Bang!
Just when Xiao Chen was trying hard to suppress the abnormal movement in the Dao Bone World, a body fell from the sky and fell heavily in front of him.
In fact, this can no longer be called a body, there is only a skeleton and human skin, and the flesh and blood have been swallowed up by the dark power!
"Just die like that?"
Xiao Chen seemed a little unbelievable that a powerful man in the Xuanfu realm was killed by darkness like this?
Or maybe he died in the hands of Yan'er?
The people of the Bai family also felt a bit dreamy. The man in gray robe could easily exude coercion and scare away their family leader, but he died so mysteriously.
boom!
After killing the gray-robed man, the Netherworld Fire Lotus seemed to be targeting Xiao Chen again, and the surging power of darkness roared towards him!
